summary.text: Backend developer with 6 years in the industry, currently tech lead of a team of 5 at SoftServe. Built a Node.js/TypeScript and PostgreSQL payment reconciliation service processing about 2 million transactions a day. Prefers boring, reliable systems.

bullets.text: Built a payment reconciliation service in Node.js/TypeScript and PostgreSQL for a US fintech client, processing about 2 million transactions a day.
Moved the team from a monolith deploy to Kubernetes (EKS), cutting deploy time from ~40 minutes to 8.
Led a team of 5 as tech lead since March 2023 and mentored 3 juniors.
Wrote internal guidelines for code review and interviewed candidates.
Worked on the Laravel backend for the courier app at a food delivery startup.
Integrated Google Maps API for route estimates.
Was on call for production incidents once a week.

education.institution: Ivan Franko National University of Lviv
